audit.why: 8/10 HARD is consistent with 52.86% over 2444 games: a 950-range poke lane Kassadin cannot answer until Riftwalk, then a target with no dash.
audit.corrected: Early is hers on range; from 6 the lane is a chase she cannot win.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes credited Kassadin's Q with a 'silence' that cancels Mantra spells.
audit.why: Riot's text for Kassadin Q is damage + interrupt CHANNELS; Karma has no channelled ability, so there is nothing for Q to cancel. The real level-9/first-item flip is Void Stone plus the magic-absorbing Q shield against a kit that is entirely magic damage.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten around Void Stone, Rod of Ages and Riftwalk closing 500 units at a time.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Focused Resolve is a tether that only roots if it is NOT broken.
audit.why: Riot's W text says the enemy is rooted only 'if the tether is not broken'. Riftwalk moves 500 units per cast against a 675-unit leash, and terrain breaks line of sight — so Kassadin has the cleanest answer in the game to it. Separately, Kassadin's E charges from spells cast in his vicinity, and Karma casts constantly, so Force Pulse is available on demand in this lane.
audit.corrected: Break the tether with Riftwalk range or a wall; expect Force Pulse charged almost permanently.
Focused Resolve flat 12s; Inner Flame 9s at rank 1 down to 5s; Mantra 40s and reduced by Gathering Fire on every damaging cast.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal anywhere on the page.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal: Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve heals her, which decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal named in itemisation against Mantra W's heal.
